title: Declare and call C functions
description: You can follow ctypes function declarations and inspect the supplied calls and values.

steps.description: The platform branches select the C library. The supplied recording uses the Linux branch.
strlen receives declared argument and return types before the call. Its result agrees with Python len for the supplied byte string: both report 13.
The code declares signatures for abs and labs. These declarations specify the C integer types for their inputs and results.

steps.question: Does the following loop call both abs and labs?
steps.answer: No. Each iteration calls libc.abs; labs is only declared here.

steps.description: The recording displays four absolute values, then constructed ctypes values and sizes. The size measurements describe the supplied platform's representations.
